correctness.rationale: The two-step return identities are necessary/sufficient; gain <=1 is excluded, including equality by irrationality of pi. For gain >1 the exact squared scalar equation admits reconstructed memory midpoints. A positive-slope resonance factor and 1-Lipschitz cosine give exactly one root in each side window for every sufficiently large even integer. Taylor expansion plus a uniform Lipschitz bound proves the O(n^-2) phase-sensitive location law. The standalone checker reconstructs 32 actual high-precision returns at four parameter pairs; it does not substitute for the infinite proof.
